result.brief: 提出多模态语义与时间过规则性（TOR）的AI生成视频检测框架，分析生成视频在细粒度视觉表征上的时间持续性差异。
result.reason: Detection of AI-generated videos using multimodal semantics and temporal regularity; contributes analysis of temporal variability in visual representations, but no generative world model or representation learning method.
